components.name: Title-Card Stage
components.description: Signature: the ultramarine field cut by one hard diagonal with a magenta edge, the shape name in display caps, wiping in once on shape change.
components.css: .ds-stage{position:relative;height:260px;overflow:hidden;background:#f7f7f2;font-family:'Big Shoulders', Impact, sans-serif}.ds-stage-field{position:absolute;inset:0;background:#1d2bd6;clip-path:polygon(0 0,44% 0,30% 100%,0 100%);animation:ds-wipe 620ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) both}.ds-stage-field::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:#ff3d7f;clip-path:polygon(43.3% 0,44% 0,30% 100%,29.3% 100%)}.ds-stage-title{position:absolute;top:30px;left:36px;max-width:40%;margin:0;color:#ffffff;font-size:48px;font-weight:900;line-height:.88;letter-spacing:.01em;text-transform:uppercase;text-wrap:balance;animation:ds-enter 520ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1) 140ms both}@keyframes ds-wipe{from{clip-path:polygon(0 0,0 0,-14% 100%,-14% 100%)}to{clip-path:polygon(0 0,44% 0,30% 100%,0 100%)}}@keyframes ds-enter{from{transform:translateX(-24px);opacity:0}to{transform:none;opacity:1}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-stage-field,.ds-stage-title{animation:none}}

narrative.overview:
Every shape is presented like an anime eyecatch: a flat ultramarine field cut by one hard diagonal, a magenta edge running along the cut, the shape's name in condensed heavy caps, the finished cel-shaded form on one side and its flat pattern on the other. The world is flat colour, black ink and white paper. There are no gradients, no glass and no soft depth; depth comes from the diagonal and from the cel shading of the model.

Underneath the graphic shell the tool is a cutting-table instrument. Pattern lines are drawn one device pixel wide over a true-scale grid, numbers sit in tabular figures, and the form gives one decision per line using standard web controls. The loud parts (field, title, magenta seam) frame the work; the quiet parts (ink lines on white paper on an off-white ground) are the work.

The system is light only. Patterns get checked against white paper on a cutting table, so there is no dark mode and none should be added.
keyCharacteristics: One hard diagonal splits an ultramarine field from the off-white ground, edged by a thin magenta band.
Condensed heavy uppercase display type (Big Shoulders 900) against a hyperlegible UI face (Atkinson Hyperlegible 400/700).
Zero radius everywhere; controls are ruled in 1.5px ink.
Pattern geometry is drawn in one-device-pixel lines at true proportion over a 1 cm or 1 in grid.
One authored motion: the diagonal wipe when the shape changes.

rules.name: The Magenta Means Here Rule
rules.body: Magenta marks exactly one thing per context: the current shape, the seam being edited, the focused control, or the diagonal edge. It never fills a button or decorates.

rules.name: The Flat Ink Rule
rules.body: Colour is applied as flat fills. Fields are a single colour cut by `clip-path`; no gradients, tints or transparency washes.

rules.name: The Longest Word Rule
rules.body: The stage title is sized from its longest word (about half an em per letter, capped by the xl size and the container width) so every word clears the diagonal. Do not let display type cross the cut.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Anywhere only values change (inputs, the stage summary readout), use tabular figures so columns don't jitter as the maker types.

rules.name: The Sticky Print Rule
rules.body: On narrow screens the paper size and the primary PDF action always stay pinned to the bottom of the viewport.

rules.name: The Cel Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: If something needs to read as raised, outline it in ink or give it a flat fill. Never use a blurred shadow.

rules.name: The One Device Pixel Rule
rules.body: Pattern lines are one device pixel wide at every zoom and pixel ratio, redrawn on resize. Never draw pattern geometry with a CSS-pixel stroke.

rules.name: The One Motion Rule
rules.body: The diagonal wipe is the only authored motion. Everything else is a 150ms colour change on hover. Don't add entrances, parallax or scroll effects.

dos: **Do** keep every corner square (zero radius) and border controls with 1.5px solid ink.
**Do** draw pattern lines one device pixel wide with a non-scaling stroke, and keep the on-screen line language (ink cut, ultramarine dashed guides, magenta lit seam) the same as the printed one.
**Do** use magenta for exactly one "this one" mark per context: the selection, the lit seam, focus, or the diagonal edge.
**Do** size display titles from their longest word so they clear the diagonal.
**Do** use tabular figures wherever values update in place.
**Do** keep paper size and Download PDF pinned to the bottom below 1024px.
**Do** turn the diagonal wipe off under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
donts: **Don't** add a dark mode; pattern checking happens against white paper.
**Don't** use shadows, gradients or rounded corners on any surface.
**Don't** fill buttons with magenta or use it as decoration.
**Don't** let display type cross the diagonal cut.
**Don't** add a second authored animation beyond the title-card wipe.
**Don't** draw pattern geometry with CSS-pixel strokes or any radius.
